description: This Java source file implements the CommandConsumerFactory interface for managing AMQP command consumers within the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles creation and management of command consumers, delegated command senders, and their liveness checks, specifically tailored for multi-tenant, device, and gateway scenarios. It includes logic for connection handling, command routing, and error handling, serving as a factory and orchestrator for messaging components related to command processing.

classes.name: CommandConsumerFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing AMQP command consumers and senders within the Eclipse Hono framework, supporting multi-tenant and gateway/device-specific routing, connection handling, and liveness checks.

classes.name: LivenessCheckData
classes.description: Represents the data associated with a liveness check, including timer ID and command handlers supplier.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the factory and its dependencies, including the gateway mapper, to the AMQP network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the factory from the AMQP network and the gateway mapper.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a tenant-scoped or device-specific command consumer with optional gateway routing and liveness checking.

methods.name: getCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Creates a new command response sender link for replies, always as a new link.

methods.name: getLegacyCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Creates a legacy command response sender link, always as a new link.
